name: The Calligraphy Database
tagline: The art of beautiful writing from the ground up: tools and strokes, major scripts from italic to copperplate, brush lettering, Asian traditions, composition, and the calligrapher's practice - every record carrying the full entry taught progressively along the ladder.

name: Signature Calligraphy Database
tagline: The Signature system's expanded treatment of calligraphy: the same real lettering knowledge carried forward, plus Signature-built script analyses, style fusions, and contemporary applications original to this system.
